query:
SELECT 
  pc.id,
  pc.parentProductId,
  p1.name as parent_name,
  pc.childProductId,
  p2.name as child_name,
  pc.quantity
FROM productCompositions pc
LEFT JOIN products p1 ON pc.parentProductId = p1.id
LEFT JOIN products p2 ON pc.childProductId = p2.id
ORDER BY pc.parentProductId DESC
LIMIT 10;
